meta.name: epic-breakdown-advisor
meta.description: Break down epics into user stories with Humanizing Work split patterns. Use when a backlog item is too large to estimate, sequence, or deliver safely.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将大型史诗拆解为可估算的用户故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果待办项太大难以估算或安全交付
copy.tagline_en: Break down large epics into estimable user stories
copy.fit_line_en: For you if backlog items are too large to estimate or deliver safely

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你一步步将大型史诗拆解成用户故事。它会先检查故事质量，然后按顺序尝试9种拆分模式，确保每个故事都能独立交付用户价值。
howto.when: 当你提出一个太大、无法估算或安全交付的后台项（史诗）时触发。例如，在冲刺规划前要求拆分大型功能。

say.text: 帮我拆分这个用户注册史诗。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成拆分流程。

say.text: 这个报表功能太大，帮我拆成小故事。
这个管理后台工作流应该用哪种拆分模式？
say.note: Claude 会推荐合适的模式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you step-by-step to break down large epics into user stories. It first validates the story quality, then sequentially applies 9 splitting patterns to ensure each story delivers independent user value.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you present a backlog item (epic) that is too large to estimate, sequence, or deliver safely. For example, before sprint planning when you need to split a large feature.

say_en.text: Help me split this onboarding epic.
say_en.note: Claude will walk you through the process.

say_en.text: This reporting feature is too big, break it down.
Which split pattern fits this admin workflow?
